title: Aion 2's Ludra patch in 50 seconds (new dungeon, title race, equal-stat PvP)
topic: Aion 2 Global patch Nov 4 2026 - Abyssal Forge: Ludra
description: Everything that matters in the Aion 2 Global patch of Nov 3 (PST) / Nov 4 (CET): the new Sanctuary dungeon Abyssal Forge: Ludra (Normal iL 2,800 / Hard iL 3,000, 1-hour runs), the Ludra Hunt title race (first 20 Hard parties per region, until Nov 25 CET), Chaotic Outer Reshanta equal-stat PvP (Lv 45+, 3 h/week), the Artifact Siege moving to Thursdays and Saturdays (+50% Abyss Corridor AP) and new 100%-success crafting recipes for True Dragon and Star Dragon gear.

parts.text: Aion 2 just got its biggest patch yet. Here's everything that matters, fast.
New dungeon: Abyssal Forge, Ludra. Normal needs item level twenty-eight hundred, Hard needs three thousand, and every run has a one-hour timer.
The first twenty parties in each region to kill Hard Ludra get an exclusive title. You have until November twenty-fifth.
Chaotic Outer Reshanta is new PvP where everyone's stats are equalized. Level forty-five and up, three hours a week.
The Artifact Siege drops to Thursdays and Saturdays, but Abyss Corridor points go up fifty percent.
And crafters: new recipes make True Dragon and Star Dragon gear with one hundred percent success. No great success combos, but no more fails.
Which change are you jumping into first?
